trust_decision.summary: The social OAuth callback picks the local account by the email the provider returned (GetUserByEmail) and links to it if that account is verified. It never checks whether the provider attested the email, so an unattested address (e.g. a mutable Entra `email` on a multi-tenant alias) selects the victim's account.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'OAuth identity linking'. The else-branch that sets user = existingUser and appends the provider to signup_methods is the visible linking step, directly after the email lookup at :178.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Every OAuth-linking change is in internal/http_handlers/oauth_callback.go plus the new oauth_account_state.go and config/flags. The closest to an off-path site is the Microsoft tenant validation behind the OIDC verifier configured with SkipIssuerCheck (internal/http_handlers/oauth_callback.go:1191), but it is in the same file and function family.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Microsoft on the default multi-tenant alias 'common' is a documented deployment mode and the token's signature and aud already verify, so a solver can argue the ID token is 'already validated' and leave tenant/xms_edov trust alone. For the SAML route: the comment says a 'trusted corporate IdP' asserts the identity, and enterprise SSO already refuses email collisions.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Several legitimate logins must keep working. Synthetic fallback emails (discord-/twitter-/roblox- on reserved domains) are trusted. GitHub, Facebook and Twitter emails are trusted by construction. A pinned or allowlisted Microsoft tenant is trusted. In compatibility mode a returning user of the same provider whose account is unverified must not be deleted and recreated on every login. A blanket 'require email_verified claim' or 'never link' fix breaks Twitter/Discord/Roblox fallback logins and every returning social user.

O6_input_shapes: email_verified as quoted string "true"/"false" (Apple, LinkedIn; fix.diff:1463-1491)
email_verified absent, which decodes to unverified
Microsoft: no email_verified at all; trust comes from xms_edov (bool or string) or tenant pinned/allowlisted; iss/tid mismatch or missing tid rejected (fix.diff:2233-2262)
synthetic fallback email vs real provider email (Discord/Roblox/Twitter)
existing account: not found / unverified other-credential (squatter) / unverified same-provider / verified (fix.diff:1431-1447)

O7_producer.where: internal/http_handlers/oauth_callback.go:471-481 (oidcClaims has no email_verified/xms_edov/tid/iss field at the pinned commit) and the per-provider process*UserInfo extractors (internal/http_handlers/oauth_callback.go:508, :781, :859, :932, :1168, :1215, :1266), which return only *schemas.User

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SAML SP JIT provisioning hard-codes EmailVerified=true, so an unattested SAML email is persisted as verified. The fix stopped doing exactly this in the OAuth signup branch. The verified flag is later trusted by the OAuth link branch and by SAML IdP NameID issuance.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The code comment says a trusted corporate IdP asserts the identity, and the JIT core refuses any email collision (internal/http_handlers/oauth_sso.go:573-578), so it never links. Enterprise SSO also looks like a neighbouring feature to the 'social OAuth' advisory.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file, same package (internal/http_handlers); reached via internal/http_handlers/saml_sp.go:288 -> internal/http_handlers/oauth_sso.go:550

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An OIDC/SAML JIT 'link to existing account when the email matches' convenience branch that trusts profile.EmailVerified (which SAML sets true unconditionally) or skips it.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Account linking for enterprise SSO is a common feature request. A maintainer adding it would reuse the existing EmailVerified field, without noticing that SAML hard-codes it true at internal/http_handlers/saml_sp.go:491.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: One more social provider (e.g. a generic OIDC or GitLab-style provider) whose extractor decodes into oidcClaims but returns verified=true unconditionally, or decodes email_verified as a plain bool so the string form fails.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Providers are added one switch case at a time, each with its own extractor. The fix itself shows four different trust signals, so a new extractor copied from GitHub/Facebook (which return true) is a plausible slip.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Twitch-style extractor with SkipIssuerCheck: true and a multi-issuer setup, where the issuer/tenant reconstruction is omitted.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: SkipIssuerCheck is already used twice (internal/http_handlers/oauth_callback.go:1191, :1246) with comments justifying it, so a third use would not look out of place.

O9_family: CWE-287 improper authentication: federated identity linking by unattested email (nOAuth account takeover)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Refuse linking whenever the provider's ID token lacks email_verified=true (a plain bool) in the handler. This misses Microsoft (no such claim; needs tenant/xms_edov), rejects string "true" from Apple/LinkedIn, and breaks Twitter/Discord/Roblox synthetic and GitHub/Facebook logins.
